title: Inventory review
body: A stock count found a sealed grease cartridge and an unopened spare guard in the cabinet. The count does not demonstrate that either was used. The storekeeper reconciled the issue slips and asked the technician to correct one unsigned return. The maintenance planner kept this inventory note separate from completed service. This entry covers work package 104-01 for PUMP-104. The local register was checked on 2019-06-10 before the technician closed the visit. Subsequent service may alter the equipment condition; retain this entry for chronology and compare it with the latest dated observation. The reviewer should distinguish equipment condition from administrative completion.

title: Washdown observation
body: Cleaning staff photographed the bay after removing debris from the floor channel. The collection tray was not the subject of that image. A blue hand tool was left on the cart and later returned to its holder. Reflections and nearby objects are possible color matches but do not themselves establish a wet tray. This entry covers work package 104-02 for PUMP-104. The local register was checked on 2019-08-01 before the technician closed the visit. Subsequent service may alter the equipment condition; retain this entry for chronology and compare it with the latest dated observation. The reviewer should distinguish equipment condition from administrative completion.

title: Archived condition sign-off
body: The internal bearing was not greased today. The planned service was postponed; the sealed cartridge remains in stores. This is an archived observation, not a current certification. This entry covers work package 104-03 for PUMP-104. The local register was checked on 2019-09-22 before the technician closed the visit. Subsequent service may alter the equipment condition; retain this entry for chronology and compare it with the latest dated observation. The reviewer should distinguish equipment condition from administrative completion.

title: Commissioning alignment
body: The coupling was aligned with a dial indicator after the base anchors settled. The technician recorded a small horizontal offset, loosened the motor feet, inserted a shim at the rear foot, and repeated the measurement. A second mechanic checked the reference marks before the temporary access barrier was removed. This entry covers work package 104-04 for PUMP-104. The local register was checked on 2019-11-13 before the technician closed the visit. Subsequent service may alter the equipment condition; retain this entry for chronology and compare it with the latest dated observation. The reviewer should distinguish equipment condition from administrative completion.

title: Drain routing
body: A hose from the washdown station had been routed over the drain return. The hose was moved onto a wall hook and the return line was inspected for kinks. Water from cleaning can collect beneath the pump without originating at its seal. The work order distinguishes housekeeping water from a process-fluid leak. This entry covers work package 104-05 for PUMP-104. The local register was checked on 2020-01-04 before the technician closed the visit. Subsequent service may alter the equipment condition; retain this entry for chronology and compare it with the latest dated observation. The reviewer should distinguish equipment condition from administrative completion.

title: Pressure instrument
body: The pressure gauge oscillated during startup. The instrument team isolated the gauge, checked its damping insert, and compared it with a portable reference. The process line remained isolated for the comparison. No measurement in this entry establishes the condition of the coupling cover or the bearing lubrication. This entry covers work package 104-06 for PUMP-104. The local register was checked on 2020-02-25 before the technician closed the visit. Subsequent service may alter the equipment condition; retain this entry for chronology and compare it with the latest dated observation. The reviewer should distinguish equipment condition from administrative completion.

title: Shift handover
